parameters.query:
SELECT ticket_id, created_at, venue, gear_item, category, severity,
       COALESCE(NULLIF(triage_notes,''), left(raw_description, 200)) AS summary,
       troubleshooting, submitter_name, COALESCE(submitter_email, submitter_phone, '') AS contact,
       (SELECT count(*) FROM ticket_photos p WHERE p.ticket_id = tickets.ticket_id) AS photo_count,
       status, resolved_at, monday_item_id,
       date_part('day', COALESCE(resolved_at, now()) - created_at)::INT AS days_open
FROM tickets
WHERE duplicate_of IS NULL
ORDER BY id;
